remarks: Imagine having a private park right outside your back door! Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the sought-after Silvermine neighborhood, this property's spectacular, level backyard is a rare find. Whether you're unwinding by the built-in fire pit on a crisp evening or enjoying the expansive green space, this outdoor setting offers a true sense of retreat. Inside, the home feels fresh with recently refinished hardwood floors and newly installed recessed lighting that creates a bright, airy atmosphere throughout. The kitchen is ready for its next chapter, featuring a suite of brand-new appliances installed just a few weeks ago. The updates extend to the functional spaces as well. The garage features a high-end GarageTek storage and organization system, transforming it into a clean, professional-grade workspace. With major essentials already addressed-including a newer roof, siding, and a generator-this home offers peace of mind. Come see for yourself!
